_about: Route presets and the default scenario for the route engine (PROMPT.md 5.3 and 5.9). Every value is PLACEHOLDER unless a source is given. Weights multiply the terms of the edge cost c(e) = dt [w_t + w_m M/M_nom + w_r R + w_d D + w_u U]: R is the hazard (caution) term, the walker cost multiplier less 1, which rises through caution ground; U is 1 - confidence. Each preset's limits override the scenario's. value_weight is what one unit of objective is worth in weighted minutes when a transect is skipped. The objective 'value' maximises science value; 'transects' maximises the number of complete transects, then value. Presets set by the team on 2026-11-09. Shelter limits are walking minutes to the rover, wherever it is parked or driving (team decision, 2026-11-10).

safest.note: Reserve 45 min, shelter within 10 min, caution (hazard) and uncertainty penalties three times Balanced's.
